q: John Bunyan yakolanga mulimu ki nga tannafuuka mubuulizi?
a: Yali muddaabiriza wa ntamu, ng'addaabiriza entamu ne sseffuliya, ng'agoberera kitaawe mu mulimu ogwo. Yazaalibwa mu 1628 mu Harrowden, mu kitundu ky'ekkanisa eky'e Elstow, mu bukiikaddyo okumpi ne Bedford, mu maka amaavu, era teyalina kuyigirizibwa wadde kifo kya makulu mu bantu. Yamala kumpi obulamu bwe bwonna nga tava mu maayiro matono agaali geetooloola ekyalo gye yabatizibwa, era teyaleka lulimi olwangu olw'abantu abaakolanga n'emikono gyabwe.

q: Kya mazima nti Bunyan yaweereza ng'omuserikale?
a: Yee. Mu 1644, ng'aweza emyaka nga kkumi na mukaaga, yayingizibwa mu ggye lya Palamenti n'aweerezebwa mu lusiisira olw'e Newport Pagnell wansi wa Sir Samuel Luke. Teyalaba ntalo nnyingi, naye teyeerabira kintu kimu: omusajja omulala yatwala ekifo kye ng'omukuumi mu kuzingiza, n'akubwa essasi ly'emmundu mu mutwe n'afa. Bunyan oluvannyuma yakibala mu bisa by'obulamu bwe, ng'akkiriza mu bwesimbu bwe obwa bulijjo nti mu kiseera ekyo tekyakwata ku mmeeme ye n'akatono.

q: Ekizibu ky'omwoyo kye yannyonnyola mu Grace Abounding kyali ki?
a: Okumala emyaka mingi Bunyan yabonyaabonyezebwa okutya nti yali akoze ekibi ekitasonyiyibwa era nti talina ssuubi, ng'akakasa nti afaanana Esawu, eyatunda obusika bwe n'atafuna kifo kya kwenenya. Wakati wa Grace Abounding to the Chief of Sinners wawandiikiddwa okulumwa okwo mu bujjuvu obutakweka kintu, era y'ensonga enkulu lwaki ekitabo kikyasomebwa. Okununulibwa kwajja mu bwangu mu nnimiro, ekirowoozo bwe kyamugwako nti obutuukirivu bwe tebwali mu mutima gwe wabula mu ggulu, mu Muntu wa Kristo yennyini: "Kaakano enjegere zange ne zigwa ku magulu gange ddala."

q: Mukyala we ow'olubereberye yalina kakwate konna ku kukyuka kwe?
a: Oboolyawo yakolera emmeeme ye ebisinga ku ebyo omuntu yenna bye yakola ng'omusumba we John Gifford tannajja, newankubadde ebyafaayo tebyakuuma linnya lye. Baali baavu nnyo, nga tebalina wadde essowaani oba ekijiiko wakati waabwe, naye yaleeta ng'omutwalo ebitabo bibiri kitaawe ow'okutya Katonda bye yamulekera: The Plain Man's Pathway to Heaven ne The Practice of Piety. Baabisoma bombi, era Bunyan yagamba nti ebitabo tebyamukyusa mutima naye byatandikawo ekintu mu ye.

q: Tumanyi ki ku muwala we omuzibe w'amaaso Mary?
a: Mary, eyazaalibwa mu 1650, yali muzibe w'amaaso, era Bunyan yawandiika nti yali agalamidde okumpi n'omutima gwe okusinga abaana be abalala bonna. Mu kusibibwa kwe ajjukirwa olw'okutwaliranga kitaawe ensumbi ya supu mu kkomera. Ekirowoozo ky'obuzibu bwe yali ayinza okuyitamu kyali kimu ku nnaku ze ezisinga obuziba ng'ali mu kkomera, kubanga, nga bwe yawandiika, teyasobola kugumira mpewo kumukuntako.

q: Lwaki Bunyan yamala emyaka kkumi n'ebiri mu kkomera, era lwaki yagaana okuteebwa?
a: Obwakabaka bwe bwazzibwawo mu 1660, okubuulira ebweru wa Kkanisa ya Bungereza ne kufuuka musango, era Bunyan n'akwatibwa olw'okukuŋŋaanya enkuŋŋaana ezitakkirizibwa mu mateeka. Ekibonerezo kye ekyasooka kyali myezi esatu, naye kyawanvuwa okutuuka ku myaka kkumi n'ebiri mu kkomera ly'e Bedford kubanga buli kusuubizibwa okuteebwa kwaliko ekisaanyizo kye kimu — nti alekere awo okubuulira — era teyakkiriza. Nga bwe yakyogera: "singa nnali nfulumye mu kkomera leero, nnandibuulidde Enjiri nate enkya, ku bw'obuyambi bwa Katonda."

q: Okusibibwa kwali kuzibu kutya eri ab'omu maka ge?
a: Bunyan teyakuumirwa mu kinnya kya kizikiza; yalina abagenyi n'ekitundu ky'eddembe, era yakola enkoba z'engatto ez'enkumi n'enkumi okusobola okuweereza ssente eka. Naye okwawukana n'ab'omu maka ge kwamuyuza, era yawandiika nti "okwawukana ne mukyala wange n'abaana bange abaavu, emirundi mingi kubadde gye ndi mu kifo kino ng'okusika ennyama okuva ku magumba." Yeegeraageranya n'omusajja amenyera ennyumba ye ku mitwe gya mukyala we n'abaana be, naye n'akkiriza nti kimusaanira okubawaayo bonna eri Katonda mu kifo ky'okulyamu olukwe okuyitibwa kwe.

q: Ddala Bunyan yawandiikira The Pilgrim's Progress mu kkomera?
a: Yatandika olugero olwo olw'akabonero mu kusibibwa kwe okuwanvu, era entandikwa yaalwo emanyiddwa ennyo eraga olugero ng'ekirooto ekyalootebwa mu Mpuku, eyali kkomera lyennyini. Ebisinga ku ebyo ebiddirira byava butereevu mu bulamu bwe, ne kiba nti omugugu n'okuggwaamu essuubi kwa Christian bifaanana ebya Bunyan yennyini. Kyafulumizibwa mu 1678 oluvannyuma lw'okuteebwa kwe, ekitundu eky'okubiri ne kiddirira mu 1685, era kyafulumizibwa emirundi kkumi n'emu mu bulamu bwe, ne kivvuunulwa oluvannyuma mu nnimi ezisukka mu bibiri — ekitabo ekyawandiikibwa omuddaabiriza w'entamu ataayingira yunivasite.

q: Kya mazima nti mukyala we ow'okubiri yamwegayiririra mu kkooti?
a: Yee. Bunyan yali awasizza Elizabeth mu 1659, era yali muto nga ali lubuto lwe bwe yakwatibwa; ekikangabwa ne kimussa mu kulumwa okuzaala okwamala ennaku munaana, era omwana n'afa. Mu 1661 yayimirira mu maaso g'abalamuzi mu Bedford, nga mwe muli Sir Matthew Hale, n'awolereza bba emirundi esatu, ng'abagamba nti: "Nnina abaana bana abato abatasobola kweyamba, omu ku bo muzibe w'amaaso, era tetulina kya kubeeraawo okuggyako ekisa ky'abantu abalungi." Hale n'amutunuulira n'obuzito n'agamba nti, "Zisanze, omukazi omwavu," naye kkooti teyamuwa kantu.

Mu August 1688 yeebagala embalaasi n'agenda e Reading okutabaganya kitaawe n'omwana we abaali bayombye, era n'abatabaganya. Bwe yali ayongerayo okutuuka e London ng'ayita mu kibuyaga, yatuuka ku nnyumba ya mukwano gwe John Strudwick e Snow Hill ng'atobye amazzi, era omusujja ne gumukwata. Yafiira eyo nga August 31, 1688, ng'alina emyaka amakumi ataano mu mwenda, era n'aziikibwa mu ntaana ya Strudwick mu Bunhill Fields wakati mu Beeyawuzi.
